text:
Maya: Quick heads-up 9999Verdant Run case follow-up. Interview with Hana tomorrow 10am PT. We need: final transcript, 1 approved pull-quote for press/webinar, short demo b-roll (10-15s). Can legal turn on quote review by EOD?
Jordan: On it. I'll record, drop master audio to Drive and run auto-transcript. Will tag when ready.
Casebot: Upload complete: https://drive.redwood/verdant_run/raw_audio_3012.mp3
Jordan: Auto-transcript looks decent but missing tech terms. Emi can you double-check `KV cache` vs `KV-cache` usages and the phrase `continuous batching`?
Emi (product): Yep. Note for quotes: prefer `continuous batching` (that's the product term). Also, avoid generic "batching" in customer-facing lines.
Alex (sales): For webinar slide we only need a 1-2 sentence soundbite by noon so SDRs can segment incoming interest. I'll build a 1-field form to capture "demo interest" + company size.
Rachel (legal): Happy to do EOD review. If customer mentions specific percentages we need written permission from Hana or redact numbers. Please post the exact candidate quote here.
Maya: Draft from Hana (raw): "Redwood reduced our per-token spend by ~40% and cut p99 latency in half." Posting for legal.
Rachel (legal): Change `~40%` to `significantly` unless Hana signs off on publishing numbers. I'll reach out to Hana's legal contact now.
Jordan: DMing Hana this minute for explicit numeric permission + a signed quote.
Maya: Also want a 30s clip of Hana saying one sentence for the webinar. Can Jordan capture a clean clip during the interview?
Jordan: Yes. I'll mark a timecode and export MP4 clip + still for social.
Alex (sales): FYI routing plan: Typeform -> webhook -> SFDC lead queue named "Verdant Webinar - Interest". Will add UTM + demo-interest flag.
Emi (product): Small wording nit: if we include a technical metric line, prefer: "We saw a reduction in per-token cost and lower p99 latency after enabling continuous batching."
Rachel (legal): If copy ends up: "We saw a reduction in per-token cost" that's fine. Numbers need signoff.
Maya: Okay next steps: Jordan upload transcript + clips, Emi send term redlines, Rachel aim for approval or redaction guidance by EOD, Alex build Typeform and webhook. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
Casebot: Reminder scheduled: Legal outreach follow-up in 4 hours.
Jordan: Upload links (will update thread once live).
